**Coaching Note (80 words):**
Your queen and rook can work together on the back rank! When your opponent's king lacks escape squares, check with the rook first to force the king away. Then your queen can follow with a devastating check that forks the king and rook—the classic back-rank pattern. Always look for back-rank weakness when your opponent's king is confined; it's one of the most powerful tactical motifs at any level. Forcing checks win material here because White's king has nowhere safe to go.
